skipped.what: ARM session: -webkit-touch-callout on session-prompt — without it iOS Safari's press-and-hold callout still fires
skipped.why: Blink does not implement -webkit-touch-callout; getComputedStyle returns "" on an element that declares it, so no reading here would be about the app. The declaration stays covered by the source scan in src/lift/liftInput.test.ts.

skipped.what: ARM session: PROBE 1 on session-touch itself — a press-and-hold on the STAGE leaves no selection
skipped.why: DOMAIN DEAD, re-measured this run rather than cited: with user-select forced to "text" on the stage, the same gesture that selects "P AND HOLD TO D" on session-prompt selects "" here (rangeCount=0). caretRangeFromPoint at the probe point is {"node":"CANVAS","offset":0,"text":""}: the node under the finger is a Skia <canvas> with no text position in it, and Blink will not start a selection inside a replaced element. No value of the fix makes this red, so it is not counted either way.

A press-and-hold on the stage spends a meet attempt, GDD §6.2 has nine, and PROBE 1's screen plus the four pans plus the four the driver needs to keep a lift off three misses is all nine. What it measures is a fact about Blink and about `LiftStage`, which every arm mounts identically, and it is measured on the session and debug arms in this same run. caretRangeFromPoint at this arm's probe point still reads {"node":"CANVAS","offset":0,"text":""}, which is the same CANVAS node with no text position in it.
